title: fix(gates): judge spec member citations in published prose, not only in comments (objectui#7995)
body:
Fixes #7995

Both properties objectui#7995 names are closed. One of them this PR closes; the other was already closed two days before the card was filed, and that half is a measurement, not an implementation. Everything below is a reading taken on this branch, and every number is reproducible from the commands quoted.

## Property 1 — prose in `content/docs/**` is judged by nothing. CLOSED HERE.

**Probe before**, on base `411a132c0`, using the gate own machinery rather than a regex — a false spec attribution planted as prose in `content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx`:

```
+ Per `@objectstack/spec`, `SelectOptionSchema.icon` is the canonical option icon key.
  ->  node scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs   exit 0   (SILENT)
```

`SelectOptionSchema` is a live export and `icon` is refused by name (`unrecognized_keys`, probed against the installed 17.3.0), so the sentence is false at the member — and the gate had nothing to say, because `sourceFiles()` walks `packages/*/src` and nothing else.

**Probe after**, same plant on this branch:

```
->  exit 1
    1 passage cites a spec member the spec does not declare:
      `SelectOptionSchema.icon`  content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx:194
```

**How.** Rule 4 at member granularity asks only whether a NAME the prose spells exists in the spec — no declaration, no compile-time tie, no claim phrase. That question is transport-free, so its scan surface widens to `content/docs/**` and **the rule itself does not move**: the citation grammar is factored into a single `memberCitationsIn`, and the TypeScript comment scanner was refactored ONTO it rather than having a second copy written beside it. Two dialects of one rule is exactly what commandment 0.1 (contract-first) forbids, and a gate is not exempt. What stays transport-specific decides nothing: a comment BLOCK is the scope on one side, a markdown PARAGRAPH on the other. That analogue is load-bearing — a markdown heading carries no sentence terminator, so without blank lines as hard boundaries the same-sentence test would measure across a heading into an unrelated section (pinned).

## Census, taken BEFORE enforcement

A gate written against an unknown population is how a scan-surface widening lands as a wall of reds. Measured on `411a132c0` against `@objectstack/spec@17.3.0`, over `content/docs/**`, with an instrumented copy:

```
documentation pages                                         184
  mentioning @objectstack/spec at all                        32
raw Symbol.member citations in those pages                  183
  naming a spec export whose member set is knowable            5
  within CLAIM_WINDOW and the same sentence                    3
    resolve against the family authored shape                  3
    excluded as Zod API                                        0
    DANGLING                                                   0
```

The three survivors are `FormViewSchema.type`, `DashboardWidgetSchema.filterBindings` and `PageHeaderProps.icon`, and all three are correct.

**Fix-or-ledger decision: neither is needed — the false set is EMPTY.** No prose correction, no waiver, no ledger, no allowlist. Under the four axes that is the only defensible outcome: 实际业务需求 — there is no measured debt to serve, so a ledger would be a declaration with nothing behind it; 项目长远合理性 — this repo has landed the shrink-only ledger idiom six times this shift and a seventh with zero rows would dilute the idiom, not extend it; 防 AI 犯错 — an empty ledger block is a name reserved for a future waiver, which is the opposite of a tightening; 创业阶段不扩散 — the widening stops at `content/docs/**`, the surface the card demonstrated, and does not reach package READMEs or `docs/adr/**`.

Also measured: skipping fenced code moves the raw count 183 to 128 and leaves the judged 5 / 3 / 0 identical, so there is no fence rule. A fence rule would have been a precision claim with nothing behind it.

## Property 2 — the dangling member tail. ALREADY CLOSED; the card premise is stale.

**Probe before**, on base `411a132c0`, a dangling member citation planted in a scanned source (`packages/types/src/select-option.ts`):

```
/** Per `@objectstack/spec`, `SelectOptionSchema.icon` is the option icon key. */
  ->  exit 1
      1 comment cite a spec member the spec does not declare:
        `SelectOptionSchema.icon`  packages/types/src/select-option.ts:61
```

The gate already judges the member tail. It has since `d28d87bf4` (PR #7617, objectui#7513, merged 2026-09-04) — **two days before objectui#7995 was filed on 2026-09-06**. The card sentence "It validates a citation at symbol granularity" describes the gate as it was before that commit.

Second, and independently: the two specimens the card names are **no longer dangling at all**. Resolved against the installed `@objectstack/spec@17.3.0` through the gate own resolver:

```
SelectOptionSchema.description  ->  LIVE
FieldSchema.rows                ->  LIVE
DashboardSchema.title           ->  DANGLING   (the third #7513 specimen, still dangling)
SelectOptionSchema.icon         ->  DANGLING   (the specimen used by the probes above)
```

17.3.0 executes the maintainer 2026-08-25 ruling on objectui#6140 / objectui#6153 and declares both keys; `packages/types/src/__tests__/select-option-spec-extension-7014.test.ts` already pins that boundary in both directions. So a PR that "corrected" those two citations today would be writing a new false claim in the opposite direction.

**Residue declared:** this PR implements nothing for property 2. It measures it, and it keeps the property under test through the shared grammar — the probe above is a leg of the ablation, and the pin asserts a comment and a page are judged identically on the same sentence.

## Ablation, on the committed tree

Every leg: trap plus restore, mutation proven on disk by a `grep -c` on the exact injected text before any result is read, restore proven by `git hash-object` equal to the `HEAD` blob AND an empty `git diff HEAD`. No build is involved — this gate is a `scripts/` entry point that reads sources directly and resolves the spec from `node_modules`, so there is no `dist/` for a stale artifact to hide in.

```
(iv) unmodified tree, same run                                   exit 0  GREEN
(i)  false PROSE citation in content/docs/**                     exit 1  RED, names file and citation
(ii) dangling member tail in a scanned source                    exit 1  RED, names the member
(iii)CORRECT prose citation (SelectOptionSchema.description)     exit 0  GREEN  (not reddening on everything)
(v)  ablate the prose call site in main(), replant (i)           exit 0  the RED vanishes
(vi) ablate the PARAGRAPH boundary                     vitest exit 1, 4 pins red
(vii)ablate the shared grammar inside the prose scanner vitest exit 1, 4 pins red
final unmodified                                    gate exit 0, vitest 69/69, git diff HEAD empty
```

Legs (vi) and (vii) exist because (v) alone does not discriminate: (v) proves the WIRING in `main()` does the work, and the unit pins stay green under it because they call the scanner directly. (vi) and (vii) are what prove the PINS bite.

## Gates, each captured by redirect and read from the gate own verdict line

```
node scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs                       exit 0
pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-spec-symbol-derivation.test.ts  exit 0   69 passed
pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/                             exit 0   120 files, 3584 passed
pnpm check:doc-snippets                                             exit 0
pnpm check:doc-examples                                             exit 0
pnpm check:doc-fences                                               exit 0
pnpm check:skill-examples                                           exit 0
pnpm check:lint-rule-coverage                                       exit 0
pnpm check:entry-guard                                              exit 0
pnpm check:control-bytes                                            exit 0
pnpm check:comment-mask-corpus                                      exit 0
pnpm check:unreferenced-sources                                     exit 0
pnpm type-check:scripts                                             exit 0
pnpm lint:root                                                      exit 0   32 warnings, 0 errors
node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs                           exit 0   no changeset owed
node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test (both paths)      exit 0   NOT GOVERNED
```

`check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-examples` and `check:skill-examples` first returned **exit 2, PRECONDITION NOT MET** (unbuilt packages) — read as NOT MEASURED, never as a failure. They were re-run after `turbo run build` and are the exit 0 above.

`pnpm lint:root` is the repository-wide root run, not a narrowed one, so no narrowing needs declaring for it. The three package-level farms (`pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm type-check` through turbo) are CI-owned; this diff is two files under `scripts/`, which no package build or package test reads.

## Filed while here

objectui#8369 — `check-lint-rule-coverage` walks gitignored build output (`apps/console/plugin.js`), so the gate and its pin both turn red after any local build and green again when the artifact is removed, with nothing else changed. Hit on this branch and confirmed independent of this diff by that control. Not touched here.

## Files

```
scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs
scripts/__tests__/check-spec-symbol-derivation.test.ts
```

No changeset is owed: neither path is published source of a released package (verified by `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, exit 0).

Draft, per the dispatch. The seat did not flip it ready and did not queue it.
